what:
External content/docs positioning (DECIDED 2026-04-20, CORRECTED 2026-04-20 after source-visibility clarification):

**Scope** (only these, skip internal specs): docs/PUBLIC_README.md, docs/LANDING_PAGE_CONTENT.md, docs/user/**, docs/marketing/**, README.md at repo root.

**Positioning:**
- Lead with **team/coordination framing** — differentiated vs. claude-mem, engram, Mem0, native Claude memory
- Make **solo-dev value immediately visible** so individuals don't bounce
- Core message options (pick one, refine): "your agent remembers across sessions, your team's agents stay aligned across developers, **free, memories live in your git repo — not in cloud**" OR "**free, private to your team, no cloud dependency**"
- Differentiators: memories in the repo (not cloud) / git syncs across team / works with Claude Code AND Cursor
- Tone: technical, confident, no hype

**CRITICAL — do NOT describe as "open source":**
aide-memory is proprietary closed-source software distributed as a binary. Source code lives in private repo and is NOT public. Product is FREE (no paid tier) but NOT OPEN (source is not available). Prohibited framings:
- ❌ "open source"
- ❌ "fully open"
- ❌ "source available"  
- ❌ "free and open"
- Anything implying source code visibility

Acceptable framings:
- ✓ "free"
- ✓ "free and private to your team"
- ✓ "free, memories live in your git repo"
- ✓ "no cloud dependency"
- ✓ "private-by-default" (memories)
- ✓ "your data never leaves your repo"

**Accuracy rules (STRICT):**
- Don't claim capabilities not implemented AND validated
- Claim Claude Code and Cursor as supported. Do NOT name Claude Desktop, Windsurf, or any other tool as supported (MCP compatibility is theoretical, not validated)
- NO mention of paid tier, pricing, or roadmap
- NO performance claims without source data
- Flag overclaiming copy — do NOT silently soften it

**Pre-writing reads (source-of-truth for what's real):** docs/PRODUCT_VISION.md, docs/specs/PHASE_0_1_SPEC.md, docs/specs/PHASE_0_1_VALIDATION_FOLLOWUPS.md.

**Deliverable:** diffs for review, NOT commits. Surface anything removed/reworked for overclaim — especially "open source" language that must be removed.
why: Original version used "free and open" in core messaging — user clarified source is NOT open. Updated to explicitly ban open-source framing and provide acceptable alternatives. Must be locked before rebrand spawn runs or diffs land.
